name: Pyromania
description: Combustible Damage Code increase +3, and burn for extra +1d6 Rounds; Must make Resolve Special Stat roll not to burn flammable liquids that enter Close Range.

name: Scorched
description: Resilience rolls against heat and flame are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Flare
description: When using Flares as a weapon, gain Advantage on Attack and Defensive Actions; Enemies in Short Range gain Disadvantage from the smoke. This Special Ability increases the EAG by 20%, but attracts the enemy to this survivor.

name: Stamina
description: When conducting a prolonged Athletic action, like Running or Swimming, the character increases the Success Requirement every 2 Resilience failures instead of EVERY Resilience failure.

name: Bravery
description: Resolve rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Robust
description: Immunity rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Trusty Axe
description: Called Shot Attacks with Axes gain Advantage (negating the Called Shot Disadvantage).

name: Survivor Mentality
description: When STARVING, Resilience can be used to negate Physical damage at 2 per Degree of Success.

name: Hollow Points
description: Choose a Favored Firearm (.38 Revolver, 9mm Auto, Autorifle, etc.). Damage Code +2 when using this Firearm; Use of other weapon types, even other firearms, is at Disadvantage.

name: Hit and Run
description: Can Take Aim once on your Turn as a Free Action.

name: Trigger Happy
description: Gain Multi-Attack with revolvers when other hand is empty.

name: Tactical Leadership
description: Command skill rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Poker Face
description: Reroll a failed Resolve roll ONCE per interaction without using a Luck Use Per Game. The second roll result must be accepted.

name: Lasso
description: Wrangle skill rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Focused Shot
description: Called Shot Attacks with Firearms or Heavy Weapons skill gain Advantage (negating the Called Shot Disadvantage).

name: Guns Blazing
description: Gain Multi-Attack with ANY automatic handguns; when dual-wielding or if the handgun already has Multi-Attack, each pistol can be fired twice. Failures on ANY shot result in an additional d100 roll. A 25 or Below on this second d100 roll results in an ally getting hit with the attack.

name: Silent Stalker
description: When UNSEEN, Archery and Firearm weapons’ Damage Codes are +2.

name: Rapid Shot
description: Gain Multi-Attack with a Bow, or ANY Firearm that does not have Multi- Attack.

name: Camouflage
description: Stealth Skill Degree of Success are +1 in Opposed rolls. Character negates 5 points of an EAG increase while moving through terrain even when not using the Stealth skill.

name: Razors Edge
description: Gain Proficiency in the Blades skill, if not proficient, when using an arrow as a melee weapon (DC Light).

name: Parkour
description: Ignore Hindering Terrain Athletics Skill rolls during Movement actions.

name: Resourceful
description: Crafting Skill at Advantage when Creating, Improving, Rebuilding, and Repairing Melee Weapons and Special Items.

name: Headshot
description: Called Shot Attacks with Bows or Crossbows gain Advantage (negating the Called Shot Disadvantage).

name: Survival Instincts
description: When STARVING with at least 1 ally, reduce all party Food Requirement per day by 1.

name: Grease Monkey
description: Crafting or Mechanics skill (Choose One) are ALWAYS at Advantage, and increase the Repair Code +1 before rolling. During Combat, Increase the Degree of Success limit +1.

name: Homemade Bombs
description: Can create 1 improved explosive for 4 during an Action Phase; Explosive does Extreme (1d8+7) damage.

name: Upgrades
description: Roll Crafting or Mechanics skill as a Combat Action to grant Damage Code+1 to a weapon for Combat Rounds equal to the Degrees of Success.

name: Locksmith
description: Lockpick skill rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Slick
description: Brawl attacks against the Mechanic are at Disadvantage; Degree of Success +1 in Opposed Grapple rolls when escaping.

name: Stunt Driver
description: Drive skill becomes Free Action ONCE per Turn during Vehicular Combat Rounds.

name: Drone Tinkerer
description: Mechanics skill trolls o create Drones are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Jury Rig
description: Increase Repair Code +2 when in a vehicle with less than ¼ Body Points. Stacks with Grease Monkey.

name: Sermon
description: In groups of 3+, Charm rolls at Advantage; Groups of 4+, gain +1 to Threshold per Person. If using Sermon for 2+ Turns, gain Advantage on Command rolls for 1d4+1 Combat Rounds afterwards.

name: Arcane Knowledge
description: Academic skill rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Blessing
description: With a Successful Resolve roll, grant 1 of the following benefits to themselves or an ally within Close Range: Protection from ALL Physical Damage for 1 Action Phase, Remove 1 level of Resolve Damage, Grant Advantage on all Resolve Special Stat rolls for 1 Combat Round per Degree Of Success, Reduce the Stages of Infection by 1 per Degree of Success, Grant a DC +1 on Attacks against Supernatural Horrors and/or Zombies

name: Collar
description: Unaffected by Hunger Damage effects from Starving or Emaciated.

name: Determination
description: Roll Resolve ONCE during Long Rest or Sleep to heal 2 Physical Damage per Degree of Success.

name: Exorcism
description: With a Successful Resolve roll, ALL Supernatural Horrors and Zombies within Midrange gain Disadvantage for 1d4 Combat Rounds. Each Action Phase the Exorcism continues, these Enemies take 2 Physical Damage. No second roll required.

name: Prayer
description: With a Successful Resolve roll, a “Natural Event” strikes ALL Enemies within Midrange with 1d6 Resilience Damage per Degree of Success; Targets can negate 2 damage per Degree of Success with a Resilience Special Stat roll.

name: Communion
description: With a Successful Resolve roll during a Long Rest, each survivor's Food Requirement is reduced by 1.

name: Martial Stance
description: Switch between Defensive or Offensive stance as 1 Free Action; Defensive Stance grants Advantage to Defensive Actions; Offensive stance grants Advantage to Fighting Skill Attacks and increases Melee Damage Codes +1, but also Disadvantage to Defensive Actions.

name: Duelist
description: Declare Opponent; until opponent is out of combat, gain +6 Initiative.

name: Iaido
description: Palming Skill at Advantage when Quick-Drawing a weapon; Increased Proficiency in Palming decreases Success Requirement. (No roll for Trained)

name: War Cry
description: ALL enemies within Short Range must make a Resolve roll to avoid becoming UNNERVED.

name: Meditation
description: Resolve rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage; During Long Rest, remove INSANITY Condition or roll Resolve to decrease Stage of Infection by 1.

name: Ninja
description: Blade Weapon Damage Codes increase +2 when UNSEEN AND attacking at Close Range or Throwing the weapon.

name: Swordsman
description: Called Shot Attacks with 2-handed weapons gain Advantage (negating the Called Shot Disadvantage).

name: Self-Sacrifice
description: Gain +5 Initiative in a group of 3+; You cannot leave Combat until ALL other allies have also left the Combat.

name: Educated
description: Choose Science, Tech Use, or Xenotech Use to gain Advantage ALWAYS.

name: Academic
description: Academics skill rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Homemade Bullets
description: Exchanges 40 to create 10 Ammunition without making a Science Skill roll ONCE per Game Day. The Ammunition increases the weapon’s DC+1.

name: Chemical Reaction
description: Create 1 improved, highly volatile, Massive Damage (2d6+3) explosive or “Stink Bomb” for 4 as your Turn; Blast Radius is Short Range. Stink Bombs cause a regular Knockout Attack (see page 69).

name: Verge of Discovery
description: Exchange 8 to create a syringe of the Z-Virus Experimental Antiserum ONCE per Long Rest without making a Science roll.

name: Blow Dart
description: Use Science skill instead of Agility to Throw a “dart” containing a serum, explosive, or Stink Bomb.

name: Invent
description: Science skill at Advantage when creating or repairing barriers.

name: Miracle Cure
description: Use Science instead of Medicine to heal wounds and decrease Stages of Infection; cost is 1 per Damage healed and 4 per Stage of Infection decreased.

name: Hippocratic Oath
description: Cannot use Riposte Defensive Action; Increase Treatment Code +2 during Combat Rounds and increase the Success Limit +1.

name: Doctor's Orders
description: Command skill rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Scrubs
description: Immunity roll Degree of Success increased +1 when wearing only “scrubs” (Armor 1) as armor (no other armor).

name: Adrenaline Surge
description: Grant 1 target +5 Initiative and increase Melee Damage Code +1 for 1 round per Degree of Success on a Medicine skill roll. This does not stack with other temporary Initiative bonuses.

name: Instinctive
description: Add Instinct Base Stat to Iniative Equation before dividing ((Agility + Luck + Instinct) ÷ 10).

name: Rescuer
description: Lifting +1 Degree of Success when carrying persons in Combat; If in Teamwork, they grant +10 per Degree of Success instead of +5.

name: Pharmacology
description: Gain 1 Level of Proficiency in the Science skill, and gain Advantage on Medicine rolls to Reduce Stages of Infection.

name: Surgeon's Hands
description: Gain proficiency in Blades skill; ALWAYS deal 8 Physical Damage when using a Scalpel as a weapon (No Damage Roll).

name: Assassinate
description: Blades, Brawl, or Clubs attack Damage Code +2 when UNSEEN AND attacking at Close Range; if target is killed, is not Increased, and other Enemies do not notice for 1d4 Action Phases.

name: Sneaky
description: Stealth skill rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage

name: Cutthroat
description: Success on Charm skill grants Advantage on ALL subsequent Charm rolls against that target until failing.

name: Reverse Psychology
description: Reroll failed Resolve roll against Intimidate or Interrogate ONCE without using a Luck Use; Can still use Luck to reroll again.

name: Ace up the Sleeve
description: Palming Skill at Advantage. Light (L) or Average (A) weapons are automatically “Palmed” as if an Amazing Success.

name: Eye on the Prize
description: +1 Item or +1d4 on Salvage rolls per Degree of Success; can be split between items or per Degrees of Success.

name: Driven by Hunger
description: ALL Perception and Salvage rolls at Advantage when STARVING

name: Rifleman
description: Gain Firearms skill Proficiency when using a Rifle as a weapon. If already proficient, gain Advantage.

name: Camaraderie
description: Gain Charm skill Proficiency when drinking alcohol. If already proficient, gain Advantage.

name: Vigilant
description: Perception skill rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Tough Guy
description: Heals +2 Health Points whenever restoring Health Points.

name: Wing Man
description: When participating in Teamwork skill actions, grant a +10 per Degree of Success instead of +5.

name: Untrusting
description: Gain Proficiency or increase Level of Proficiency with the Interrogate skill AND Gain Advantage on Resolve rolls against the Charm Skill.

name: Survival Training
description: When Starving, Gain Advantage and increase +1 Food Unit per Degree of Success when Foraging.

name: Loyal Companion
description: Gain a Loyal Companion with Command Actions; If companion dies, Disadvantage to ALL rolls, but Damage Code +1 on ALL Attacks. Review the Core Rulebook for more information on loyal companions.

name: Sixth Sense
description: Whenever Ambushed in Combat, you do not lose your first action, nor take the Initiative Penalty.

name: Mental Parry
description: Resolve rolls ALWAY at Advantage. You are also not at Disadvantage against Resolve Attacks if you possess a Psychic Power.

name: Tightening the Belt
description: Gain +4 extra points on the Starving and Emaciated thresholds (+8 total) due to prolonged periods without food.

name: Anarchist
description: Gain Advantage on ALL Defensive Actions when fighting more than 1 opponent within Short Range.

name: Hunter Force Unit
description: Gain Advantage on all Fighting and Ballistic skill rolls against Kaiju. Also, gain Advantage on Attack Actions if at least 1 ally is within Close Range.

name: Fear Experienced
description: Resolve rolls against Intimidate and Interrogate actions are at Advantage because you have looked down the mouth of a Kaiju.

name: Exposure
description: Reroll any failed Immunity rolls against Radiation damage ONCE per instance without using Luck Use per Game.

name: Desensitized
description: You do not need to make Resolve rolls against being UNNERVED at the sight of death and carnage.

name: Survival of the Fittest
description: When fighting Human (non-Mutant or Zombie) enemies, gain Advantage to ALL Attack Actions and increase Melee weapon Damage Codes +1.

name: Road Warrior
description: Gain +5 to Initiative during Vehicular Combat Rounds.

name: Rage Against the Machine
description: When fighting Robot enemies, gain Advantage to ALL Attack and Defense Actions, and increase Melee weapon Damage Codes +1.

name: Exposed Wiring
description: Reroll any failed Resilience rolls against Electricity-based damage, including from Knock-out weaponry, ONCE per instance without Luck Use.

name: Escape Artist
description: Reroll any failed Athletics or Contort rolls to manage hindering terrain. The outcome of the second roll must be accepted.

name: Sudden Drop
description: Roll the Resilience Special Stat at Advantage when falling and negate 4 points of Physical damage per Degree of Success instead of 2.

name: Huntsman
description: When fighting Supernatural Horrors, gain Advantage to ALL Attack and Defense Actions, and increase Melee weapon Damage Codes +1.

name: Darksight
description: Upon Encounters with Supernatural Horrors, roll Instinct. A Success reveals the Traits & Abilities of the creature and grants Advantage to Resolve Special Stat rolls against Fear Attacks.

name: Skepticism
description: Success Requirements for Resolve Attacks against you increase +1 over your Resolve Degrees of Success. However, you cannot gain the benefits of Resolve-Based Special Abilities, like the Priest Special abilities.

name: Faith
description: Gain +3 Luck Use per Game because you have strong Faith in your deity. However, must spend ALL your actions during 1 Long Rest each day in devotion to your deity.

name: Displaced
description: Gain Advantage to ANY skill of choice because you come from another place and time, perhaps the future, perhaps the past. However, you are not sure where you are currently and are thus unable to provide "spoilers."

name: Deja Vu
description: You can spend YOUR Luck Use per Game rerolls to redo ANY immediate action, including those done by allies or enemies. This action must have just occurred and results in a reroll as you remember the event happening differently.

name: Restructured Immunity
description: You are immune to the Z-Virus. ALL other Immunity Special Stat rolls are ALWAYS at Advantage.

name: Reaper
description: When fighting Zombie enemies, gain Advantage to ALL Attack and Defense Actions, and increase Melee weapon Damage Codes +1.
